title: Why Ballpoint Pens Have a Ball

lines.say: Why does a ballpoint pen have a ball?
It's the cap and the roller, in one.
Rolling drags thick oil ink out of the tube.
Usually tungsten carbide, in a brass socket.
lines.caption: TUNGSTEN CARBIDE

lines.say: The barrel is injection molded, like the toy brick.
The tip closes around the ball, then ink is injected.
In advanced factories, a pen takes under five minutes.
lines.caption: UNDER 5 MINUTES
